title: Export resolved instrument waveforms
changes: Export selected PCM, fixed-rate PCM, CGB square and CGB wave instruments as 32 kHz mono WAVs at the chosen key and duration, repeating stored loops and ending unlooped PCM at its sample length.
Keep unsupported instruments unavailable and state that the normalized waveform export omits driver effects and the CGB mute setting.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-instrument-wav-synthetic-uno61ye_ checked resampling, loop boundaries, one-shot length, all four types and existing audio controls; unit rom-data-viewer-instrument-wav-decoder-10eyw6q9 independently decoded all four WAVs with Python.

Protected local-page Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-instrument-wav-local-3g_6k5r0 checked four actual stored instrument kinds and unchanged embedded data. Docker unit rom-data-viewer-instrument-wav-docker-h7atiora matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: Pitch and interpolation are approximate; exports omit original driver effects. The local check used existing embedded data while the source dataset volume was unavailable; physical audio and native Windows remain unverified.
